turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I just checked my inbox and saw that Northgate price notice with the new listed price. You really should have given me a heads-up about that instead of staying silent and leaving me to find it myself.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text:
That email came in today and I should have drawn your attention to it rather than leaving you to spot it yourself.

The alert says the item you were watching has dropped again, but it doesn't name the product in the body — I'd need to sign in to see the offer details. Can you tell me what item it is? I can check the current price and, if you want, help you order it at the new listed price.
